label: Grounded-beginnings omission, strictness, no-re-import and nonvacuity controls
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls, every individual counted concrete, two mutually accessible worlds. (1) Natural-number times, one individual present only at time 1 of the selected world, no grounds: grounds-not-ceased and well-founded grounding hold; grounded beginnings and inert emptiness fail. (2) Natural-number times, individual false present only at time 0 and individual true only at time 2 of the selected world, false grounding true: grounded beginnings and well-founded grounding hold; grounds-not-ceased and inert emptiness fail. (3) Times WithBot Int, integer individual n present at every integer time from n on at the selected world, nothing present at the first moment, each individual grounded by its predecessor: grounded beginnings and grounds-not-ceased hold; well-founded grounding and inert emptiness fail. (4) One individual present at every time of the selected world and existing only there, no grounds: the three principles and the traced form hold, and no concrete individual exists at both worlds. (5) Individual false present at every time of both worlds, individual true present only at time 1 of the selected world, no grounds: inert emptiness holds and the traced form fails. (6) The same history with false grounding true: the three principles, presence-to-existence and the possible contingent-free past hold, and individual false is a concrete individual existing at both worlds. These are statements about these finite interpretations only.
